The structure of Eu4Ge2Pd2 crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-3m1 (No. 164), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms across 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies two main environments: tetrahedral Eu centers coordinated by 4 Ge neighbors (2 atoms, 2 orbits) and octahedral Pd centers coordinated by 6 Eu neighbors (2 atoms, 1 orbit), while Ge centers show 9 geometric neighbors (2 atoms, 1 orbit). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Eu tetrahedra and Pd octahedra, as well as edge-sharing between Pd octahedra, forming a 3-dimensional connectivity network.
